faq.question: What does Wahyu mean?
faq.answer: Wahyu is associated with the Arabic form وَحْي, whose core sense is wahyu; revelation (indonesian form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Wahyu?
faq.answer: Wahyu is associated with Arabic. Wahyu is the Indonesian form of Arabic وَحْي (Waḥy), meaning 'revelation'. It is used as a male given name.

faq.question: Is Wahyu an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form وَحْي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Wahyu an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Wahyu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Wahyu a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Wahyu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root و ح ي is Quranic (revelation), but Waḥy is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Wahyu mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Wahyu is rendered وحی and carries the sense وحی، وحی.

faq.question: What are the variants of Wahyu?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Wahyu, wahyu. Script forms are وحي, وحی, وَحْي, वह्यु.
